findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find, search_people, get_person, request_appointment · Private data: search_people, get_person, create_profile_draft, request_appointment · Public sink: book, get_person, create_profile_draft, request_appointment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find, search_people, get_person, request_appointment · Private data: search_people, get_person, create_profile_draft, request_appointment · Public sink: book, get_person, create_profile_draft, request_appointment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_person" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
